subject: Re: Model mix & token volumes — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & token volumes — post-call recap and next steps

Alex — great talk today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can align on pricing and a draft mutual action plan (MAP).

Summary of what I heard on the call:
- Primary product: customer support chatbot (chat completions) integrated into web/CRM.
- Secondary uses: semantic search + reranking for FAQ answers (embeddings + rerank).
- Approx initial user base: 10k monthly active users with peak concurrency needs for chat.
- Current target launch: Q3 2027, pilot with 2k users first 60 days.

Token volume estimates (your inputs):
- Chat (multiturn): ~200M tokens/month at pilot scale, growing to ~1.8B tokens/month by steady state.
- Embeddings (search + classification): ~120M tokens/month steady state.
- Rerank (batch reranks + live): ~40M tokens/month.
- Total projected steady-state: ~1.96B tokens/month.

Model mix you preferred for cost/quality balance:
- Chat: mix of gpt-chat-3.5-ish for standard dialogs + gpt-chat-4-like for premium flows (~80/20 split by volume).
- Embeddings: text-embed-2-large for semantic search.
- Rerank: small rerank-optimized model.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) I will send a short pricing sketch with target unit economics and a $/1M token target range for your model mix.
2) You to confirm any hard budget constraints for the pilot (monthly $ ceiling).
3) Share any compliance or SSO/KMS requirements we should include in a private deployment quote.
4) Schedule a procurement/contract intro with Ben and Lauren next week if pricing looks okay.

Ben — looping you for procurement sync and to prep a standard Delta/DocuSign starter.

Attachments: I will follow up with a token projection spreadsheet (v2).

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

---
Sent from my mobile — apologies for any brevity.

From: Alex Johnson <alex@brightlayer.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & token volumes — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A couple clarifications and one constraint from procurement: 

Clarifications:
- The 200M chat tokens/month is for the pilot (2k users). If the pilot KPIs are good we expect 9x expansion to the steady state numbers you listed.
- For chat model mix we actually prefer: 70% gpt-chat-3.5-like for standard, 25% gpt-chat-4-like for complex flows, and 5% gpt-chat-4o-like for analytics/long-context sessions. Can you reflect that split in the pricing sketch?
- Embeddings usage will include periodic full-index re-embeds (monthly) plus per-query embeddings; the 120M is our average steady state number.
- Rerank will be used for two batch jobs per day plus some live reranking; 40M is an OK estimate.

Procurement constraint:
- Pilot budget target is $18k/month (absolute max) for third-party inference + infra. If the pilot requires more we need strong justification tied to unit economics and a clear migration path (e.g., dedicated capacity or on-prem options).

Happy to hop on another 20-min call to walk through the model mix math if helpful. Also please flag any compliance items (SOC2, KMS) now — we'll need them in the MAP.

—Alex
VP Product, BrightLayer
alex@brightlayer.ai | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & token volumes — pricing sketch + unit economics (v1)

Alex — thanks for the clarifications. Attached is a short pricing sketch and a token projection (BrightLayer_token_projection_v2.xlsx) with a model-mix tab that reflects your updated splits. Key notes and target unit economics below.

Pricing sketch (high level) — target $/1M tokens by model family (pilot / steady-state guidance):
- Chat (gpt-chat-3.5-like): unit price target = $35 per 1M tokens (pilot pricing anchor).
- Chat (gpt-chat-4-like): unit price target = $240 per 1M tokens.
- Chat (gpt-chat-4o-like): unit price target = $420 per 1M tokens (low volume, premium).
- Embeddings (text-embed-2-large): $20 per 1M tokens (embedding units).
- Rerank: $8 per 1M tokens (rerank-optimized small model).

Using your steady-state volume (~1.96B tokens/month) and the 70/25/5 chat mix, blended nominal cost estimate (list-ish) is roughly: $
- Chat blended: 70%*35 + 25%*240 + 5%*420 = $ approx 79.75 per 1M tokens for chat portion (blended).
- Weighted across total volumes yields an approximate monthly spend: ~ $155k/month (list).

Pilot scenario (200M chat tokens + 120M embeddings + 40M rerank):
- At the pilot pricing anchor above pilot spend projection = ~$18.1k/month (this intentionally aligns with your $18k pilot budget; we can tighten with a pilot discount or usage commit).

Options to hit procurement target ($18k/month):
1) Pilot discount: 20–30% off list for the first 3 months (we can provide a formal addendum).
2) Commit/Reserved pool for Dedicated: fixed monthly commit that drops unit prices significantly after you hit thresholds.
3) Model routing: route low-latency, low-cost flows to quantized variants for chat (saves ~15–25% on chat unit cost).

Ask: please confirm which option you prefer for the pilot (pilot discount vs reserved commit vs routing strategy). If you want, Ben and Lauren can run a quick contract sketch and a 3-month MAP.

Compliance: we support SOC2, SSO/OIDC, and KMS integrations. If you need a private deployment or HSM-backed keys we'll include that as a separate line in the MAP.

Attached: BrightLayer_token_projection_v2.xlsx (tabs: summary, model_mix, monthly_projection, assumptions).

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm pilot option and any hard limits on monthly spend.
- BrightLayer procurement: if pilot discount accepted, we'll follow with a 3-month trial addendum and pilot SOW.
- Redwood: Ben to schedule procurement intro and prepare DocuSign starter.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk the spreadsheet tomorrow.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142
